subject: Hobgoblin Warrior
picture: One medium athletic hobgoblin soldier leads a shield-wall drill in an underground barracks tunnel. The leader must look unmistakably like a rugged goblinoid soldier rather than a handsome elf or human: heavy brow ridge, broad blunt face, broad flat nose, small pointed ears, strong jaw, short coarse hair, no tusks, and an upright military posture. Three other hobgoblin soldiers form the drill line behind him with three overlapping rectangular shields and planted feet. A large shield rack stands against the wall. The tunnel has a stone ceiling, large block walls, and a closed wooden gate at the far end. Keep shield faces plain and free of emblems. The drawing reaches all four edges.
